# Local UI fonts

Comfortaa (400, 500, 600, 700) and DM Sans (400, 500, 600), downloaded from
Google Fonts on 2026-10-16. `ui.css` retains the served face definitions, with
local URLs so the UI has the same metrics without an internet connection.

Sources: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Comfortaa and
https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DM+Sans. Each family is distributed under
its accompanying SIL Open Font License. The offline asset manifest includes
only the stylesheet and font binaries.
